strings.zh: 渡『{VAR:0103:0},当听说你打败坂木{NEWLINE}揭穿他火箭队老大身份的时候,{CLEAR}整个精灵联盟都非常震惊。{SCROLL}渡『既惊讶于坂木馆主{NEWLINE}居然是火箭队的幕后黑手,{CLEAR}更惊讶于有人居然能将他打败。{SCROLL}渡『我作为四天王的首领,{NEWLINE}将用一场倾尽全力的战斗,{CLEAR}向你表达崇高的敬意！{CLEAR}请问你是希望进行单打还是双打？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Lance: {VAR:0103:0}, when we heard you’d{NEWLINE}beaten Giovanni and exposed him as the{CLEAR}boss of Team Rocket, the whole{CLEAR}Pokémon League was stunned.{SCROLL}Lance: We were shocked that Gym Leader{NEWLINE}Giovanni was the mastermind behind Team{CLEAR}Rocket, and even more shocked that{CLEAR}anyone could beat him.{SCROLL}Lance: As head of the Elite Four, I’ll{NEWLINE}show you my deepest respect with a{CLEAR}battle where I give everything I have!{SCROLL}Would you prefer singles or doubles?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: League branch: #0–18 (Lance's room: Indigo Conference battle, then rematches). Rocket-occupation branch: #19–43 (Marauder and Lawrence); #19–34 = ‘one at a time’ path, #35–37 = ‘together’ path.

strings.zh: 渡『竟然打败了我的龙系军团……{SCROLL}渡『恭喜你赢得了胜利,{NEWLINE}你现在是精灵联盟的「联盟冠军」了！{CLEAR}本来应该是这么跟你说的。{CLEAR}不过你的朋友小绿刚刚也战胜了我,{CLEAR}所以要成为「联盟冠军」,{CLEAR}你还要跟他进行一场最终决战才行。{CLEAR}他就在前面的冠军房间里,{CLEAR}你快去吧！
strings.en: Lance: You defeated my dragon corps...{SCROLL}Lance: Congratulations on your victory.{SCROLL}You are now the Pokémon League’s{NEWLINE}Champion!{SCROLL}That’s what I would normally say,{NEWLINE}anyway.{SCROLL}But your friend Blue has just beaten me{NEWLINE}as well.{SCROLL}So to become League Champion, you’ll{NEWLINE}have to face him in one final battle.{SCROLL}He’s in the Champion’s room ahead. Go{NEWLINE}on!

strings.zh: 渡『身为四天王,{NEWLINE}言行、实力都必须够格{CLEAR}成为全地区训练家的表率才行。{CLEAR}跟你一比我还需要好好修炼啊。
strings.en: Lance: As one of the Elite Four, my{NEWLINE}words, my conduct and my strength must{CLEAR}all set an example for every Trainer in{CLEAR}the region.{SCROLL}Compared with you, I still need much{NEWLINE}more training.

strings.zh: 全地区的观众{NEWLINE}都会通过我的摄像机看到你的英姿哟！
strings.en: Viewers across the region will see your{NEWLINE}finest moments through my camera!

strings.zh: 需要我帮您恢复精灵吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Shall I heal your Pokémon?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 您的精灵已经恢复了。
strings.en: Your Pokémon are fully healed.

strings.zh: 渡『全国的训练家{NEWLINE}都在以你为目标而努力,{CLEAR}我也不例外！{SCROLL}渡『你现在有时间{NEWLINE}与我来一场检验实力的战斗吗？{CLEAR}单打或双打都可以。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Lance: Trainers all over the country{NEWLINE}are working hard with you as their goal,{CLEAR}and I’m no exception!{SCROLL}Lance: Do you have time now for a{NEWLINE}battle to test our strength?{SCROLL}Singles or doubles, either is fine.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 单打
strings.en: Singles
strings.notes: v3 TM: 6 source(s); other variants: 1 more v3 TM candidate (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 双打
strings.en: Doubles
strings.notes: v3 TM: 5 source(s); other variants: 2 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 渡『好的,请多指教！
strings.en: Lance: Very well. I look forward to it!

strings.zh: 恢复精灵
strings.en: Heal Pokémon

strings.zh: 前往下一个房间
strings.en: Go to the next room

strings.zh: 没事了
strings.en: Never mind

strings.zh: 好的,我现在为您恢复。
strings.en: Certainly. I’ll heal them now.

strings.zh: 好的,我现在为您开门。
strings.en: Certainly. I’ll open the door for you{NEWLINE}now.

strings.zh: 先不打了
strings.en: Not now
strings.notes: v3 TM: 3 source(s); other variants: 3 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 门已经开了,您随时可以通过。
strings.en: The door is open. You may go through{NEWLINE}anytime.

strings.zh: 您好{VAR:0103:0}大人,{NEWLINE}请问您是要恢复精灵{CLEAR}还是前往下一个房间？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello, {VAR:0103:0}.{SCROLL}Would you like me to heal your Pokémon,{NEWLINE}or will you go on to the next room?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你的精灵数量不够,{NEWLINE}无法进行双打。
strings.en: You don’t have enough Pokémon for a{NEWLINE}double battle.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『比夏斯,吉尔露太！{NEWLINE}我已经打倒了一大半火箭队干部,{CLEAR}你们不要再做无谓的抵抗了,{CLEAR}赶紧交出人质和精灵然后投降！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Marauder, Lawrence!{SCROLL}I’ve already beaten more than half of{NEWLINE}Team Rocket’s Executives.{SCROLL}Stop this pointless resistance.{SCROLL}Hand over the hostages and the{NEWLINE}Pokémon, and surrender!

strings.zh: 比夏斯『你能打败六名干部走到这里,{NEWLINE}确实值得称赞。
strings.en: Marauder: Beating six Executives to get{NEWLINE}here is certainly praiseworthy.

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『但连续不断的战斗{NEWLINE}让你疲态尽显,{CLEAR}现在你已经是强努之末了。
strings.en: Lawrence: But battle after battle has{NEWLINE}worn you out.{SCROLL}You’re at the end of your rope.

strings.zh: 比夏斯『面对精灵得到强化{NEWLINE}并手握传说中精灵的我们,{CLEAR}随便一个人都可以将你打倒。
strings.en: Marauder: With our enhanced Pokémon{NEWLINE}and Legendary Pokémon, either one of{CLEAR}us alone could take you down.

strings.zh: 有信心打倒我就来试试吧
strings.en: Try it, if you think you can win

strings.zh: 你们一起上我也不会输的
strings.en: Even both of you can’t beat me

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『跟我一起一路走来的伙伴,{NEWLINE}绝不会比你手中的强化精灵差,{CLEAR}就算是传说中的精灵,{CLEAR}我也一样可以打败！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: The partners who’ve come all{NEWLINE}this way with me are every bit as good{CLEAR}as your enhanced Pokémon.{SCROLL}Even Legendary Pokémon, I can beat{NEWLINE}just the same!

strings.zh: 比夏斯『你确实赢了几场{NEWLINE}跟传说中精灵的战斗,{CLEAR}但我的代欧奇西斯是与众不同的。{CLEAR}分身吧,代欧奇希斯！
strings.en: Marauder: You’ve won a few battles{NEWLINE}against Legendary Pokémon, but my{CLEAR}Deoxys is different.{SCROLL}Split, Deoxys!

strings.zh: 代欧奇希斯『Deooo……
strings.en: Deoxys: Deooo...

strings.zh: 比夏斯『代欧奇希斯！{NEWLINE}你这就不行了吗……？
strings.en: Marauder: Deoxys! Is this all you’ve{NEWLINE}got...?

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『比夏斯大人,{NEWLINE}能跟联盟冠军战斗到这样,{CLEAR}已经非常不容易了,{CLEAR}下面就交给我吧。{CLEAR}我会把过去所有的账,{CLEAR}一次性地跟他讨回来！
strings.en: Lawrence: Master Marauder, holding out{NEWLINE}this long against the League Champion is{CLEAR}already quite a feat.{SCROLL}Leave the rest to me. I’ll settle every{NEWLINE}past score with him in one go!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『比夏斯大人,{NEWLINE}能跟联盟冠军战斗到这样,{CLEAR}已经非常不容易了,{CLEAR}下面就交给我吧。{CLEAR}我会把过去所有的账,{CLEAR}一次性地跟她讨回来！
strings.en: Lawrence: Master Marauder, holding out{NEWLINE}this long against the League Champion is{CLEAR}already quite a feat.{SCROLL}Leave the rest to me. I’ll settle every{NEWLINE}past score with her in one go!

strings.zh: 洛奇亚『Luuu……
strings.en: Lugia: Luuu...

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『连坚不可摧的洛奇亚{NEWLINE}都被打败了！？
strings.en: Lawrence: Even the indestructible Lugia{NEWLINE}has been beaten!?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这样一来,{NEWLINE}你们火箭队的有生力量,{CLEAR}就只剩最后三个人了。{CLEAR}我们精灵联盟一定会取得最终的胜利！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: That leaves Team Rocket with{NEWLINE}just three fighters.{SCROLL}The Pokémon League will win in the end!

strings.zh: 赢了！最终的胜利一定属于我们！{NEWLINE}打倒火箭队！取得最终胜利！
strings.en: We won! Final victory will be ours! Down{NEWLINE}with Team Rocket! On to final victory!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我是有些累了,但像你们这种{NEWLINE}无法与精灵心意相通的训练家,{CLEAR}来多少都不可能打败我。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Sure, I’m a little tired.{SCROLL}But Trainers like you, who can’t{NEWLINE}connect with their Pokémon, could never{CLEAR}beat me, no matter how many of you{CLEAR}there are.

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『你好像对自己充满信心呢。
strings.en: Lawrence: You seem awfully sure of{NEWLINE}yourself.

strings.zh: 比夏斯『那就让我们告诉你,{NEWLINE}这份自信是多么的愚蠢！
strings.en: Marauder: Then let us show you just how{NEWLINE}foolish that confidence is!

strings.zh: 吉尔露太『我本来是彩虹市的一方巨富,{NEWLINE}都是因为你从中搅局,{CLEAR}我的火箭队干部身份才会暴露。{CLEAR}我就是做鬼也不会放过你的！
strings.en: Lawrence: I was one of the richest men{NEWLINE}in Celadon City!{SCROLL}It was your meddling that got me{NEWLINE}exposed as a Team Rocket Executive.{SCROLL}I won’t let you go, even if I have to{NEWLINE}haunt you from the grave!

strings.zh: 比夏斯『坂木老大使用的阿尔宙斯,{NEWLINE}是最强的传说中精灵,{CLEAR}你一定会败在老大的手上。
strings.en: Marauder: The Boss’s Arceus is the{NEWLINE}strongest Legendary Pokémon there is.{SCROLL}You’re sure to fall at the Boss’s{NEWLINE}hands.

strings.zh: 达马兰奇主席和部长先生们{NEWLINE}就在前面的房间,{CLEAR}请冠军大人快去救他们吧。
strings.en: President Goodshow and the department{NEWLINE}heads are in the room ahead.{SCROLL}Please hurry and save them, Champion.

strings.zh: 火箭队一冲进联盟办公大厅,{NEWLINE}就开始查找经济、人口、训练家数据,{CLEAR}看来他们是真的奔着取代精灵联盟{CLEAR}统治整个地区来的。
strings.en: As soon as Team Rocket stormed the{NEWLINE}administration hall, they started{CLEAR}digging through economic, population{CLEAR}and Trainer data.{SCROLL}They really mean to replace the{NEWLINE}Pokémon League and rule the region.

strings.zh: 科技部的部长先生{NEWLINE}被火箭队拉出去了,{CLEAR}不知道他现在是否平安无事。
strings.en: Team Rocket dragged off the head of{NEWLINE}the Technology Department.{SCROLL}I hope he’s safe.

strings.zh: 我也是拥有8枚徽章的精英训练家,{NEWLINE}可是在火箭队的干部面前完全不够看。
strings.en: I’m an Ace Trainer with eight Badges{NEWLINE}too, but I’m no match at all for Team{CLEAR}Rocket’s Executives.
